descriptionChirho: To move about aimlessly or flee from a place, often as a displaced fugitive or vagabond (Qal of physical displacement).
To express grief, condolence, or sympathy for someone, often by mourning or lamenting (Qal of emotional response).
To move back and forth unsteadily, to sway or totter like a drunkard or a tree in the wind (Qal/Hitpael of physical oscillation).
To wag or shake the head as a gesture of derision, pity, or astonishment (Hitpael reflexive gesture).
To groan or moan in personal lamentation, expressing intense inner grief (Hitpael reflexive/intensive of lamenting).

labelChirho: cause to wander, shake, drive away
descriptionChirho: To make someone wander or flee, to shake or move something forcefully, or to drive away (Hifil causative).
